providers: official Italian institutional and motorway sources

method.interpretation: Exact autocomplete confirms wording, not monthly demand. The A22 selection uses a broader corridor signal plus a dated official tariff change; the primary truck phrase is not claimed as an exact suggestion.
method.volumePolicy: Keep volume null unless a dated Italy-specific dataset is available.

candidates.productFit: Verified spreadsheet inputs can be handed manually to a supported single-route estimate, three price scenarios, local archive and non-binding PDF.
candidates.productBoundary: RouteBudget does not import or export Excel files, manage clients or contracts, synchronize rate tables, or provide live routing and cost data.
candidates.intentBoundary: Owns spreadsheet architecture, date validity, input controls, version history and mobile handoff. Generic trip-cost formulas remain with the existing cost pillar and calculator.

candidates.productFit: A dated and documented fuel-price input feeds the trip fuel estimate, price scenarios and non-binding PDF.
candidates.productBoundary: RouteBudget does not fetch a live diesel price, import fleet invoices, calculate excise refunds or decide fiscal and contractual treatment.
candidates.intentBoundary: Owns selection and documentation of the price input for today's quote. Fuel-consumption measurement and contractual fuel surcharge keep their existing owners.

candidates.signalNote: The primary phrase 'pedaggio A22 camion' was not returned as an exact suggestion. Selection uses directional A22 corridor variants plus Autobrennero's official 1.46% tariff update effective 1 January 2026.
candidates.productFit: A class-and-casello toll verified in the official A22 calculator becomes one trip-cost input for scenarios and the non-binding PDF.
candidates.productBoundary: RouteBudget does not calculate or pay the official A22 toll live, choose the vehicle's official class, or replace Autobrennero's calculator.
candidates.intentBoundary: Owns the A22 Italian corridor, Assi-Sagoma class, entrance/exit selection and 2026 tariff change. The general Italian toll method keeps its existing guide.

rejectedCandidates.reason: Real task, but fiscal risk and quarterly maintenance are high and product conversion is less direct than documenting today's fuel input.
The 2026 application window had closed by 22 July and eligibility is narrower than a route-cost task for micro-carriers.
RouteBudget does not model pallets, groupage, volume, handling or multi-stop pricing, so product fit is insufficient.
